response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) AS avg_of_avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM per_type

assumptions.assumption: 'Large' means Bytes strictly greater than 10,323,804. Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded by this filter.
Bytes per millisecond is computed with real (non-integer) division, and the track count is the number of large tracks in each media type.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Large' means Bytes greater than or equal to 10,323,804.
